$comment: Where the build is. One line per cycle in docs/PROGRESS.md; this is the machine-readable head.

health.$note: Every number here is measured, never estimated: packages/publicSymbols from `npm run lint` (it prints both), tests/testFiles from `npx vitest run`. publicSymbols is the raw sum of kit.json exports, which is what lint prints; site/data/measured.json reports 524 for the same kit because it de-duplicates names that several packages share (VERSION). An earlier set of values here was written from memory and had drifted by 543 tests, 14 files and a whole package — agents read this file first, so a number in it that nobody measured is worse than no number.
